title: Universal Type-I Stack Normal Form
purpose: Normalize any bounded printable/hybrid Type-I stack into one deterministic evidence-bearing packet without replacing child recipes or collapsing distinct physical regimes.
rules: 2D intent is logical connectivity/function, not as-built geometry.
3D region/interface geometry controls actual adjacency, parasitics, mutual coupling, transport paths and seed boundaries.
4D state stores only consequential time/history/environment/configuration variables.
SG-0 requires zero discrete seed references; SG-1 exactly one; SG-N at least two.
Field/transport regimes are explicitly declared from UTP-146 and are never silently merged into a universal equation.
Self/mutual coupling slots remain OPEN_SYMBOLIC, SYMBOLIC, SOLVED, MEASURED or HOLD; absent data are never treated as zero.
Passive SG-0 cannot exhibit net active gain beyond attributable external input plus released stored energy within uncertainty.
Process ordering reuses child recipes and may not cross child/interface/preservation/safety/evidence gates.
Any consequential geometry/material/process/boundary/seed revision invalidates dependent numeric coupling state.
Normalization creates no physical execution, certification, release, public, carrier-promotion or high-consequence authority.
